concerns.text: Falling back to unverified X-User-Id and X-User-Role headers directly if not present in request attributes might allow header spoofing if the upstream gateway does not strip them.
The extractUserId helper method catches IllegalArgumentException and silently swallows it, returning null. While safe, logging a warning could improve serviceability.
In DocumentSearchControllerTest.java, analyticsEventRepository.deleteAll() is called inside testSearchLogging() right after being called in setup() @BeforeEach. This is redundant.
